snippet.title: Tachyon Dreams Trailer (New Free Text-Parser Adventure Game Out Now)
snippet.description:
Tachyon Dreams is a new, free text-parser adventure game with EGA pixel art graphics that faithfully recreates the style of mid/late 80's Sierra AGI games. Get it on Itch: https://cosmicvoid.itch.io/tachyon-dreams-1-the-radiant-fish-of-the-apocalypse

Follow me on twitter: https://twitter.com/Cosmic_Void_
